canonSafeguards: Never overwrite a confirmed source value with generated content.
Never replace a confirmed lower bound, classification, explicit unknown, or live runtime constraint with an unlabeled procedural value.
Keep candidate or disputed source records separate from confirmed records.
Unknown remains unknown in AUTHORITY_ONLY mode.
DERIVED content requires a traceable rule and parent inputs.
PROPOSED content requires explicit proposal mode and cannot be promoted to canon by repetition.
The live T0-T8 shared capability tier and P0-P6 Path level are distinct; an explicit Path level controls the shared-tier baseline through the live mapping rather than being overwritten by it.
A generated vessel instance may become authoritative for that instance only when its authority snapshot, resolver choices, complete scale coordinates, seed, and generator version are retained.
Generated instance authority never silently rewrites setting-wide race, technology, or transit canon.
FTL does not authorize chronology violation or time travel without explicit source authority.
